anatomy: Reptilian humanoid with thick, leathery, dark brown skin; several thin, sensory feelers or barbels extend from the jaw and brow; small, deep-set eyes
coloration: Uniformly dark, earthy brown skin with deep folds and wrinkles; no visible hair or scales; matte finish to the skin texture
attire_and_adornment: Heavy, dark grey ceremonial robes with intricate geometric patterns; a central breastplate features glowing blue recessed circuitry
posture_and_expression: Shoulders hunched slightly forward; chin raised to emphasize the sensory feelers; expression is one of stoic, enduring patience
distinctive_traits: The alien's neck is remarkably thick and segmented, blending into a wide, powerful torso that suggests a high-gravity origin
